Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0` is clean. Its first parent is the PR head above.

The diff adds one source guard and its decision record. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision check, stock simulation, or UI rendering. Before/after screenshots do not apply. No recorded program or golden file changes.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/tests/colour_literals.rs:164`: Handle inline line comments before you count literals. The filter removes only lines that start with `//`. Thus `Color32::from_rgb(1, // red\n2, 3)` counts as zero, although all three arguments are numeric literals. A new colour can pass the guard. In the other direction, `let x = 0; // Color32::WHITE` counts as one colour, although the colour occurs only in a comment. Both reviewer probes fail. Remove line comments, including comments after code, without changing string contents. Add regression tests for both cases.
2. `crates/ui/tests/colour_literals.rs:1`: The new file creates a top-level test binary. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under **New tests join a directory suite**, requires a one-line reason in the PR body. Add the reason for a separate binary, or put the guard in an existing theme test suite. The body describes the guard but does not explain this placement.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. One step, zero failures. `ui suites: colour_literals`: 3 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: PASS. Six steps, 11 tests passed, zero failures or stalls. The release build passed.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps -p camcraft-ui --test colour_literals -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `rustfmt --check crates/ui/tests/colour_literals.rs`: PASS.
- A direct `rustc --edition=2024 --test` run of the source guard: 3 passed.
- Two separate reviewer probes in `/tmp`: FAIL as expected for finding 1. The constructor probe returns 0 instead of 1. The trailing-comment probe returns 1 instead of 0. The PR source was not changed.

Extra suites run: The light lane ran `motion lib` (7 passed), `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `app pocket_pass_start` (1 passed each). No fixture or importer suite applies. The diff changes no fixture, importer, post, operation, motion code, or catalog. Full heavy lanes were not run.

The draft state, labels, and title stay unchanged, as the review request requires. The review worktree and its build cache remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The review items on 7614c70db are done. The new head is e4b71bb0d.

1. **Comments after code.** The scanner now removes comments before it counts: `//` to the end of the line (also after code) and `/* */` (also nested). It keeps the text of string and char literals. Your two probes are now tests in `a_comment_after_code_neither_hides_nor_adds_a_literal`: `from_rgb(1, // red` then `2, 3)` counts 1, and `let x = 0; // Color32::WHITE` counts 0. A second test, `strings_and_char_literals_keep_their_text`, covers a `//` in a string and in a raw string, a `'"'` char literal, a lifetime, and a nested block comment. The counts of `crates/ui/src` do not change.
2. **Test placement.** The guard is no longer a top-level binary. It is two modules of the existing `theme_files` suite: `tests/theme_files/colour_literals.rs` (the allow-list and the tree walk) and `tests/theme_files/colour_scan.rs` (the scanner, split for the 400-line law). The `theme_files` gate map now also names `ui::egui_app`, so each UI change runs the guard.

Gate on e4b71bb0d: quick gate 1 step (`ui suites: theme_files`, 22 tests), 0 failed. `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: clean. The PR body has the new paths and test names.

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e4b71bb0d36f500f55601eb13d04ae3bf1ca58c8 -->
Clean review. No changes are required before merge.

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c` is clean. Its first parent is the PR head above. I checked the full diff against the current upstream `AGENTS.md`.

Earlier findings:

1. **Fixed: comments after code.** Commit `e4b71bb0d36f500f55601eb13d04ae3bf1ca58c8` removes line comments and nested block comments before the count. The test `colour_scan::a_comment_after_code_neither_hides_nor_adds_a_literal` passes both earlier probes. The constructor with an inline comment counts as 1. The colour name in a trailing comment counts as 0. The string, character, lifetime, and nested-comment tests also pass.
2. **Fixed: test placement.** The guard and scanner are modules of the existing `theme_files` suite. No new test binary is added. The suite's gate map now includes `ui::egui_app`.

Local results on the trial merge:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. One step, zero failures or stalls. The local build passed. `ui suites: theme_files`: 22 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy --no-deps -p camcraft-ui --test theme_files -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `rustfmt --check crates/ui/tests/theme_files/colour_literals.rs crates/ui/tests/theme_files/colour_scan.rs`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: no heavy lane reached. No heavy tests were run.

Extra suites run: None. The diff changes no test fixture, importer, post, operation, motion code, or catalog. The full changed `theme_files` suite ran in the quick gate.

Safety and evidence: This PR changes tests and a decision record only. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, gouge check, collision check, or stock simulation. Safety-tier mutations do not apply. Both earlier scanner probes are now green regression tests. No recorded program or golden file changed. No UI rendering changed, so before/after screenshots do not apply.

Requested before merge: None.

The PR is `MERGEABLE`. The draft state, labels, and title stay unchanged, as this review request requires. The review worktree and its build cache remain in place. No PR code was changed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand. Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 3990` so it can merge on this review.
